YOGAS FOR EYE DEFECTS : If at the time of Adhana (or at birth), the Sun and Moon are in Leo identical with Lagna, the child born will be blind; there should be aspect of Mars and Saturn on Leo. A bubble on the eye should be predicted if Marsand Mercury aspect the said Sun and Moon in Leo Lagna. I shall further explain yogas affecting the eyes. Should the 12th be occupied by waning Moon, left eye is destroyed and if by the Sun, it is the right eye. If, how- ever, benefics aspect (the said 12th and the Sun/Moon), then by (suitabje) efforts, the eye can be repaired. Notes :
